integrity: Exact signed integer chain complexes, integral Smith normal forms, and rational signed symmetry computations supplied in reproducible code. Known nonequivariant homotopy theorem is acknowledged and excluded from novelty.
scientific_limitations: A finite computer-assisted theorem for one complex, not a family-wide theorem or full integral S5-module decomposition; general flag-minimum-support lemma invoked; originality subject to unindexed literature; independent validation not performed.
title: Shortest octahedral spheres and integral symmetry orbit lattices in the Petersen matching complex
